### DECISIONS so far
- D1 spine set: readFace's edge spines ∪ its `through` spines that reach X's own edge-spine kerb X_E by `reaches` (:449). Lemma: a through spine that does not reach X_E has B(s) ∩ X_E = ∅ (reaches is a superset test incl. touching), so X over all through spines ≡ X over the reaching ones — a pin, and why the key may hold only the reaching ones.
- D2 parts: each spine's runs after straightRun's drop (spineParts(s, box, true) — the faithful read's parts) so a straight-through vertex (a neighbour's T on S) changes no part ⇒ X unchanged; this is 986 (c)'s 'under splitThrough the state is unchanged' and §3.7's T sentence (ARCH :5362–5364). Cost: vs the FIRST (unreduced) construction read, a ≤ ~1.5 cm difference at a straight-through vertex — counted as its own sub-class 'straight-through' of NEAR. Alternative (unreduced) would re-key every neighbour at every T (SCOPE-3). → put as a QUESTION with this recommendation? decide: recommend D2, ask confirm.
- D3 rounding: every output vertex is an input vertex (of F's route rings or of a part) or snap() of the exact intersection of two ORIGINAL segments (exact rational, one rounding, roundHalfAway); region computed in ONE pass over all parts (no sequential clip), so order-independent by construction; the seat states how a rounding that would make a ring non-simple is resolved (e.g. hot-pixel snap rounding of the whole arrangement — order-independent) and proves simplicity by simpleRing on every output.
- D4 normal form = KerbRead.region's: ownRings where no part reaches F; else dropStraight (keep where the boundary meets itself) → canonicalRing → unspiked → filter → sort(compareRings), as dryRegion :1617–1626.
- D5 'unmoved' flag: computed from what the dry-run laid (every part laidExactly, none collapsed/unlaid, not restaged, faithful not taken) and kept in a by-path diagnostic beside CENSUS (a second WeakMap, LastRead unchanged so every kerbCensus pin stays).

## Step 9 — more decisions (design of the rewrite)
- D6 X must build no Plat (winding.ts's overlay calls createPlat): the shadow sits INSIDE readKerb, so dryrun.test.ts's per-kerb() counts (createPlat 0, insertChain = parts, opSave ≤ 1/2/4, work/warnings/journal untouched) become X's write-nothing pins for free. X = an in-memory exact arrangement of F's route rings and the parts.
- D7 key ring-vertex rule: drop a route vertex v of F's ring from the key iff straight-through on the ring (straightRun's HOT_PIXEL line test against kept ring neighbours u, w; no hw term) AND the triangle (u, v, w) is covered by ONE of X's parts (coveredBy's exact test, kerb.ts:1684). Proof: region differs only inside that triangle ⊂ ⋃ parts. Spines keyed by the parts' inputs (straightRun-reduced runs as spineParts' reach filter keeps them for F's actual box, hw samples, closed/whole, junction flags, declared ends) ⇒ (k1) immediate. Through spines keyed only where they reach X_E (lemma D1 makes X independent of the others). L2 content outside: routes and rings are level ≤ 1 only (readFace :357; routeLines own level).
- D8 relation classes (shadow and test): EQUAL; ≤1CM (two-sided Hausdorff ≤ 1 cm, exact or ≤ 0.25 cm sampled; sub-class 'straight-through': a difference within 2·HOT_PIXEL_CM of a vertex X's drop removed); ATTRACTED (moved read: two-sided ≤ DRY_MOVE_CM AND every difference beyond 1 cm within DRY_MOVE_CM of the outline of a part not laid exactly); BEYOND → arbitrated by the definition oracle: X wrong ⇒ FAIL; X right & construction wrong ⇒ the construction's (Q110 (c) / Q117 tips / new), listed; neither wrong ⇒ FAIL on an unmoved read (X must be ≤1CM there; a lying flag is this round's defect). The 2 cm planted control then fails by 'neither' on unmoved reads.
- D9 CITY arbitration: the definition oracle runs INSIDE the shadow at read time through a by-path judge hook (setExactJudge) the probe installs from kernel/test/arr/bands/definition.ts (oracle code stays in tests); arena form: chain routes by the oracle's own walk or tx/profile.ts routeLines/knotLines/cutKnot (M0-a-06's, shared with readSpine — named), widths from the read's callback, junction ends by the oracle's own rule written from §3.7 + S15; never readFace/readSpine/junctionEnd/reaches/spineParts/bufferParts/straightRun. Grid 100 cm on every face + 20 cm on BEYOND, vertex tests both sides.
- D10 shadow log: module-level in kerbExact.ts (vitest isolates modules per file), per distinct kerbKey: first-read class, X time; X recomputed at EVERY read and compared with the key's first X (k1 at CITY: a violation THROWS); construction varying under one key counted (DESIGN-5's residual, REPORTED). Cap 200 000 keys, overflow counted (probe gate: 0 overflow).
- D11 cost: source-mode figure from the shadow's hrtime around exactKerb (exact, no sampling); prod figure from a scratch prod bundle in the mirror with the seam forcing the shadow (bundle.ts entry gains one import in the MIRROR only): --mode cpu --fns exactKerb --interval 100, inclusive by name ÷ count-run calls (resolved by file:line), VOID below 500 samples or when inlined (repeat the built driver.mjs under node --no-turbo-inlining).
- D12 NO-SHIFT bundle check: count run --fns …,exactKerb,kerbKey on the tree: 0 calls in S8's window; text check of <out>/driver.mjs: exactKerb's only call site inside the shadow, the shadow's only call behind the DEBUG_BUILD guard.
- D13 corpus: B-FUZZ chord networks (chordArb's form, network()) + wideNetwork; lanes 2–3 points between two boundary points of F (on spine edges → T; on the frame), hw 1–300 scalar or two-knot, splitFace rows [{role:'way', entity:'lane:k'}], connectHole outer→hole; depth 3; numRuns fixed 100 per property at the PR size (PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS/100, min 10); floors: ≥ 2 000 faces judged and ≥ 300 cuts per run; bands NEAR ≤ base + 1 800 s.
